govulncheck_origin: Stage ci_go.go installs @latest in a source-free container. This port records the actual installed binary hash per run and mounts it read-only for scanning.
trivy_origin: Stage security_trivy.go uses latest. This port records pulled descriptor/local ID and uses that exact image ID for both scans; no immutable cross-run scanner pin is claimed.
rollback_benign_pattern: no migrations to run|no next version found|no migration found|no previous version|no current version found
migration_scope: fresh synthetic database up, last-three down, up replay; not populated-data restoration or production rollback acceptance
